label: copy-phase input z (z being fed back during copying)
explanation: Fires only on copy-phase steps whose input is the letter z (the model re-reading a z it already copied); never on z in the original phase, on the delimiter, or on any other input token. Recall is 1.0 on dev, but only about 62% of copy-phase z inputs activate. Firing rate and magnitude increase with step t / recall_idx: at t<=6 it is rare and weak, and the top activations (~3.5) are at the last copy steps of L=8-9 sequences, e.g. a z that sat at original position 7. Adding t>=7 or recall_idx thresholds barely changes precision (0.66-0.70), and so do conditions on repeated z, prev_tok, or out_tok. Which z inputs stay below threshold is not captured by any simple variable I tested.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: z, -, f, x, 3, b; least: d, w, u, <DEL>) and the next token to output (most: u, r, d, i, n, v; least: l, b, -, z); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, t=17, recall_idx=8.
